data.label: Maritime Governed Record
data.description: A maritime port authority record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier, and the digital signature proof. Members: Port Call Record; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov); Digital Signature Proof.

items.label: Digital Signature Proof
items.description: Cryptographic proof of attestation (digital signature)

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: Port Call Record
items.description: A vessel's call at a Cordova port: the port call ID, the NIEM port visit (port, expected and actual arrival and departure), the NIEM vessel (name, IMO, MMSI, call sign, flag, dimensions and tonnage, owner and operator), the NIEM voyage, crew and passenger counts, a person on the vessel (Default demographics, crew role, embarkation), the cargo manifest and port fees. Members: Port Call ID; m-port-visit (NIEM); m-vessel (NIEM); m-voyage (NIEM); Crew Count; Passenger Count; m-person-on-vessel (NIEM); Cargo Manifest; Port Fees.

items.label: Port Call ID
items.description: Unique identifier for this port call record. Assigned by Porto Sereno Port Authority.

items.label: Crew Count
items.description: Total number of crew members aboard the vessel at time of port call. Required for immigration processing, shore leave management, and emergency muster planning.

items.label: Passenger Count
items.description: Total number of passengers aboard the vessel at time of port call. Required for immigration processing, disembarkation planning, and port facility capacity management. Zero for cargo-only vessels.

items.label: Cargo Manifest
items.description: The cargo declared for a port call: the NIEM cargo (category, weights, volumes, customs value, hazmat declaration with the UN/NA coded value, origin and destination), the container count and the shipper's business registry number. Members: m-cargo (NIEM); Container Count; Business Registry Number.

items.label: Business Registry Number
items.description: Cordova Business Registration Number. Format: BIZ-NNNNNN where NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number assigned at incorporation. Required for all business filings, tax records, and port authority transactions.

items.label: Container Count
items.description: Number of shipping containers in the cargo consignment measured in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units). Used for berth planning, crane allocation, and port throughput statistics.

items.label: Cargo
items.description: A data type for a good or goods transported by a conveyance. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoType. Members: Cargo Identification; Cargo Category; Item Description; Cargo Gross Weight; Cargo Net Weight; Cargo Tare Weight; Cargo Chargeable Weight; Cargo Drained Weight; Cargo Gross Volume; Cargo Net Volume; Cargo Diameter; Cargo Customs Value Amount; Cargo Hazardous Material Indicator; Hazmat Declaration; Cargo Packaged Indicator; Cargo Residue Indicator; Cargo Origin Location Reference; Cargo Destination Location Reference; Item Requires Temperature Controlled Storage Indicator; Item Minimum Acceptable Temperature; Item Maximum Acceptable Temperature.

items.label: Cargo Hazardous Material Indicator
items.description: True if cargo contains hazardous material; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoHazardousMaterialIndicator.

items.label: Cargo Packaged Indicator
items.description: True if the cargo is packaged; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoPackagedIndicator.

items.label: Cargo Residue Indicator
items.description: True if the cargo is residue; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoResidueIndicator.

items.label: Item Requires Temperature Controlled Storage Indicator
items.description: True if temperature controlled storage is required; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 m:ItemRequiresTemperatureControlledStorageIndicator.

items.label: Cargo Category
items.description: A kind of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoCategoryText.

items.label: Cargo Destination Location Reference
items.description: An intended destination of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoDestinationLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Cargo Identification
items.description: An identification of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Cargo Origin Location Reference
items.description: An origin of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoOriginLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Item Description
items.description: A description of an item. NIEM 6.0 nc:ItemDescriptionText.

items.label: Cargo Chargeable Weight
items.description: A measure of the gross weight or mass of cargo on which a charge is to be based. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoChargeableWeightMeasure. A quantity in the Mass Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Customs Value Amount
items.description: A monetary value of cargo as it relates to customs and importation. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoCustomsValueAmount. An amount of money in the Default currency units by slot.

items.label: Cargo Diameter
items.description: A measure of the diameter of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoDiameterMeasure. A quantity in the Length Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Drained Weight
items.description: A measure of the drained weight of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoDrainedWeightMeasure. A quantity in the Mass Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Gross Volume
items.description: A measure of the total gross volume of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoGrossVolumeMeasure. A quantity in the Volume Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Gross Weight
items.description: A measure of the total weight or mass of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoGrossWeightMeasure. A quantity in the Mass Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Net Volume
items.description: A measure of the net volume of cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoNetVolumeMeasure. A quantity in the Volume Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Net Weight
items.description: A measure of the net weight or mass of cargo, excluding both packaging and transport equipment. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoNetWeightMeasure. A quantity in the Mass Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Cargo Tare Weight
items.description: A measure of the weight or mass of transport means for cargo including permanent equipment but excluding goods and loose accessories. NIEM 6.0 m:CargoTareWeightMeasure. A quantity in the Mass Units (SI and customary).

items.label: Item Maximum Acceptable Temperature
items.description: A measure of the maximum acceptable storage temperature for something. NIEM 6.0 m:ItemMaximumAcceptableTemperatureMeasure. A quantity in the Temperature Units (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin).

items.label: Item Minimum Acceptable Temperature
items.description: A measure of the minimum acceptable temperature. NIEM 6.0 m:ItemMinimumAcceptableTemperatureMeasure. A quantity in the Temperature Units (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin).

items.label: Hazmat Declaration
items.description: A data type for a declaration of hazardous materials within transported goods. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationType. Members: Hazmat Declaration Chemical Common Name; Hazmat Declaration Description; Hazmat Declaration UN Hazmat (hazmat); Hazmat Declaration Hazmat Class; Hazmat Declaration Flash Point; Hazmat Declaration UN Hazmat Page; Hazmat Declaration Origin Location Reference; Hazmat Declaration Destination Location Reference; Contact Information (NIEM).

items.label: Hazmat Declaration Chemical Common Name
items.description: A name of a chemical that is commonly used. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationChemicalCommonName.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration Description
items.description: A description of a hazardous material listed on a hazmat declaration. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationDescriptionText.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration Destination Location Reference
items.description: An intended destination for a hazardous material listed on a hazmat declaration. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationDestinationLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration Hazmat Class
items.description: A US DOT (U.S. Department of Transportation) hazmat class pertaining to a hazardous material. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationHazmatClassText.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration Origin Location Reference
items.description: An origin of a hazardous material. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationOriginLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration UN Hazmat Page
items.description: A set of textual content of a hazmat declaration page. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationUNHazmatPageText.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration Flash Point
items.description: A measure of the lowest temperature at which a hazardous material can form an ignitable mixture in air. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationFlashPointMeasure. A quantity in the Temperature Units (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin).

items.label: Contact Information (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for how to contact a person or an organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactInformationType. Members: contact-point (Default); Contact Information Availability Code; Contact Information Description; Contact Entity Description; Address (NIEM).

items.label: Contact Entity Description
items.description: A description of the entity being contacted. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactEntityDescriptionText.

items.label: Contact Information Description
items.description: A description of the contact information. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactInformationDescriptionText.

items.label: Contact Information Availability Code
items.description: A period of time or a situation in which an entity is available to be contacted with the given contact information. NIEM 6.0 nc:ContactInformationAvailabilityCode. Codes of nc:ContactInformationAvailabilityCodeSimpleType (6 values).

items.label: Address (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for a geophysical location described by postal information. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressType. Members: international-address (Default); Address Category Code; Address Full; Address Secondary Unit; Address Private Mailbox; Address Recipient Name; Address Urbanization Name; Address Building Name; Address Delivery Point; Address County Name; County (fips); Address Postal Extension Code.

items.label: Address Building Name
items.description: A name of a specific building at an address to distinguish it from other buildings at the same site. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressBuildingName.

items.label: Address County Name
items.description: A name of a county, parish, vicinage, or other such geopolitical subdivision of a state. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressCountyName.

items.label: Address Delivery Point
items.description: A single place or unit at which mail is delivered. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressDeliveryPointText.

items.label: Address Full
items.description: A complete address. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressFullText.

items.label: Address Postal Extension Code
items.description: An identifier of a smaller area within a post office-assigned zone for an address. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressPostalExtensionCode.

items.label: Address Private Mailbox
items.description: A private mailbox within a company. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressPrivateMailboxText.

items.label: Address Recipient Name
items.description: A name of a person, organization, or other recipient to whom physical mail may be sent. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressRecipientName.

items.label: Address Secondary Unit
items.description: A particular unit within a larger unit or grouping at a location. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressSecondaryUnitText.

items.label: Address Urbanization Name
items.description: An urbanization denotes an area, sector, or residential development within a geographic area. Commonly used in Puerto Rican urban areas, it is an important part of the addressing format, as it describes the location of a specific street whose name may occur multiple times within the same ZIP Code. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressUrbanizationName.

items.label: Address Category Code
items.description: A kind of address. NIEM 6.0 nc:AddressCategoryCode. Codes of nc:AddressCategoryCodeSimpleType (5 values).

items.label: County (fips)
items.description: A unique county, parish, vicinage, or other such geopolitical subdivision of a state. A coded value: the US County5 Digit code, its display text and the fixed code list fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType (3222 codes), resolved on the list IRI. NIEM 6.0 fips:CountyCode.

items.label: Code List: fips US County5 Digit
items.description: The code list of a coded value, fixed: fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType (3222 codes). A data type for unique 5-digit US county codes, with a 2-digit state code followed by a 3-digit county code. NIEM 6.0 fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code: the preferred label of the code (SKOS prefLabel). In NIEM the equivalent is the *Text substitution beside a *Code.

items.label: County Code (fips)
items.description: The US County5 Digit code: A unique county, parish, vicinage, or other such geopolitical subdivision of a state. NIEM 6.0 fips:CountyCode, coded in fips:USCounty5DigitCodeSimpleType.

items.label: International Address
items.description: A mailing address in any country: street lines, city, region, postal code, country and use.

items.label: Address (Line 1)
items.description: The first line of a street address: street number and name, or a post office box.

items.label: Address (Line 2)
items.description: The second line of a street address: apartment, suite, unit, building or floor, when the first line does not carry it.

items.label: City Name
items.description: The name of the city, town or village in an address.

items.label: Postal Code
items.description: The postal code of an address in any country, with no format constraint. Use US ZIP Code or Canada Postal Code where the format is known.

items.label: Region Name
items.description: The name of the state, province or other administrative region in an address, written out rather than coded.

items.label: Address Use
items.description: The purpose of an address.

items.label: Country Code ISO 3166
items.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of a country or territory: the complete list of 249 officially assigned codes. Each value is defined by its Wikidata entity.

items.label: Contact Point
items.description: Ways to reach a person or organization: phone, fax, email, website, and the method and use of the contact.

items.label: Website URL
items.description: The URL of a web page or online resource, such as an organization's website or a person's profile page.

items.label: Email Address
items.description: An email address. The pattern requires a local part, an at sign and a domain with a dot; RFC 5321 limits the whole address to 254 characters.

items.label: Fax Number
items.description: A facsimile telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Phone Number
items.description: A telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Contact Method
items.description: The communication channel of a contact point.

items.label: Contact Use
items.description: The purpose of a contact point.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration UN Hazmat (hazmat)
items.description: A United Nations/North American (UN/NA) Hazardous Materials Code pertaining to a hazardous material. A coded value: the Hazmat code, its display text and the fixed code list hazmat:HazmatCodeSimpleType (2369 codes), resolved on the list IRI. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationUNHazmatCode.

items.label: Code List: hazmat Hazmat
items.description: The code list of a coded value, fixed: hazmat:HazmatCodeSimpleType (2369 codes). A data type for a United Nations/North American (UN/NA) Hazardous Materials Code pertaining to a hazardous material. NIEM 6.0 hazmat:HazmatCodeSimpleType.

items.label: Hazmat Declaration UN Hazmat Code (hazmat)
items.description: The Hazmat code: A United Nations/North American (UN/NA) Hazardous Materials Code pertaining to a hazardous material. NIEM 6.0 m:HazmatDeclarationUNHazmatCode, coded in hazmat:HazmatCodeSimpleType.

items.label: Person on Vessel
items.description: A data type for a person on a vessel with embark/debark information. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonOnVesselType. Members: person-demographics (Default); Crew Role Code; Crew Role; Person Cabin Number; Person Embarkation Date; Person Debarkation Date; Person Embarkation Location Reference; Person Debarkation Location Reference; Person Country Of Residence ISO3166 Alpha2 (iso_3166); Visa; Contact Information (NIEM).

items.label: Crew Role
items.description: A role a crew member fulfills on a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:CrewRoleText.

items.label: Person Cabin Number
items.description: A cabin number on a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonCabinNumberText.

items.label: Person Debarkation Location Reference
items.description: A location where a person debarked from a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonDebarkationLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Person Embarkation Location Reference
items.description: A location where a person embarked on (boarded) a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonEmbarkationLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Crew Role Code
items.description: A code for a role a crew member fulfills on a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:CrewRoleCode. Codes of m:CrewRoleCodeSimpleType (87 values).

items.label: Person Debarkation Date
items.description: A date and time a person debarked from a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonDebarkationDate.

items.label: Person Embarkation Date
items.description: A date and time a person embarked on (boarded) a vessel. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonEmbarkationDate.

items.label: Person Country Of Residence ISO3166 Alpha2 (iso_3166)
items.description: A country of residence. A coded value: the Country Alpha2 code, its display text and the fixed code list iso_3166:CountryAlpha2CodeSimpleType (249 codes), resolved on the list IRI. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonCountryOfResidenceISO3166Alpha2Code.

items.label: Code List: iso_3166 Country Alpha2
items.description: The code list of a coded value, fixed: iso_3166:CountryAlpha2CodeSimpleType (249 codes). A data type for country, territory, or dependency codes. Sourced from ISO 3166 Part 1. NIEM 6.0 iso_3166:CountryAlpha2CodeSimpleType.

items.label: Person Country Of Residence ISO3166 Alpha2 Code (iso_3166)
items.description: The Country Alpha2 code: A country of residence. NIEM 6.0 m:PersonCountryOfResidenceISO3166Alpha2Code, coded in iso_3166:CountryAlpha2CodeSimpleType.

items.label: Person (Demographics)
items.description: The demographic core of a person record: name, date of birth, administrative gender, language and country.

items.label: Administrative Gender
items.description: The gender a person is recorded as for administrative purposes. Not clinical or biological sex; see Sex (Recorded).

items.label: Language Code
items.description: The ISO 639-1 two-letter code of a language: the complete list of 184 codes, which are also the BCP 47 primary language subtags. Each value is defined by its Wikidata entity.

items.label: Date of Birth
items.description: The date a person was born.

items.label: Full Name (Person)
items.description: The parts of a person's name and how the name is used.

items.label: Given Name (Person)
items.description: The name given to a person at birth or naming, distinguishing them from others in the same family. Also called first name or forename.

items.label: Middle Name (Person)
items.description: An additional given name, placed between the first given name and the surname.

items.label: Name Prefix
items.description: An honorific or title placed before a person's name, such as Mr., Ms., Dr. or Prof.

items.label: Name Suffix
items.description: A suffix placed after a person's name, such as Jr., Sr., III, PhD, MD or Esq.

items.label: Surname (Person)
items.description: The family name of a person, shared with other members of the family. Also called last name or family name.

items.label: Name Use
items.description: The purpose or context of a person's name.

items.label: Visa
items.description: A data type for a travel document allowing international travelers to enter a country for a designated purpose within a designated period of time. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaType. Members: Visa Number ID; Visa Control Number ID; Visa Foil Number ID; Visa Application Date; Visa Application Disposition Status; Visa Application Location Reference; Visa Cancel Category Code; Visa Cancel Category Description; Visa Waiver Indicator; Document Category Code; Document Issue Date; Document Expiration Date; Document Identification; person-demographics (Default); Person Citizenship Country (genc).

items.label: Visa Waiver Indicator
items.description: True if a visa waiver has been granted to the ALIEN; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaWaiverIndicator.

items.label: Document Identification
items.description: An identification that references a document. NIEM 6.0 nc:DocumentIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Visa Application Disposition Status
items.description: A final status of the visa application. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaApplicationDispositionStatus. The status as text (nc:StatusText).

items.label: Visa Application Location Reference
items.description: A place where Visa Application was entered. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaApplicationLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Visa Cancel Category Description
items.description: A description of a category of reason for invalidating a previously issued permission to enter the United States. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaCancelCategoryDescriptionText.

items.label: Visa Control Number ID
items.description: An identifier for the VISA by DHS Citizenship and Immigration. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaControlNumberID.

items.label: Visa Foil Number ID
items.description: An identifier that is pre-printed on the Non-Immigrant Visa (NIV) or Immigrant Visa (IV) foil by the manufacturer. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaFoilNumberID.

items.label: Visa Number ID
items.description: An identifier for a Visa Travel Document. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaNumberID.

items.label: Document Category Code
items.description: A kind of document. NIEM 6.0 scr:DocumentCategoryCode. Codes of scr:DocumentCategoryCodeSimpleType (66 values).

items.label: Visa Cancel Category Code
items.description: A category of reason for invalidating a previously issued permission to enter the United States. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaCancelCategoryCode. Codes of scr:VisaCancelCategoryCodeSimpleType (8 values).

items.label: Document Expiration Date
items.description: A date after which the document is no longer valid. It may indicate a document should be removed from a registry or index. NIEM 6.0 nc:DocumentExpirationDate.

items.label: Document Issue Date
items.description: A date at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated. NIEM 6.0 nc:DocumentIssueDate.

items.label: Visa Application Date
items.description: A date of the Visa Application. NIEM 6.0 scr:VisaApplicationDate.

items.label: Person Citizenship Country (genc)
items.description: A country that assigns rights, duties, and privileges to a person because of the birth or naturalization of the person in that country. A coded value: the Country Alpha3 code, its display text and the fixed code list genc:CountryAlpha3CodeSimpleType (280 codes), resolved on the list IRI. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonCitizenshipCountry.

items.label: Code List: genc Country Alpha3
items.description: The code list of a coded value, fixed: genc:CountryAlpha3CodeSimpleType (280 codes). A data type for country codes. NIEM 6.0 genc:CountryAlpha3CodeSimpleType.

items.label: Person Citizenship Country Code (genc)
items.description: The Country Alpha3 code: A country that assigns rights, duties, and privileges to a person because of the birth or naturalization of the person in that country. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonCitizenshipCountry, coded in genc:CountryAlpha3CodeSimpleType.

items.label: Port Fees
items.description: A port fee: type, payment status, amount in Córdobas and date. Members: Fee Type; Payment Status; Port Fee Amount; Fee Date.

items.label: Fee Type
items.description: Type of port fee assessed

items.label: Payment Status
items.description: Whether the fee has been paid

items.label: Port Fee Amount
items.description: Fee amount assessed for port services in Cordova Córdoba. Includes berth rental, pilotage, tug assistance, waste disposal, and other harbor charges per the Porto Sereno fee schedule.

items.label: Fee Date
items.description: Date the fee was assessed

items.label: Port Visit
items.description: A data type for an actual or expected visit of a vessel to a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortVisitType. Members: Port; Visit Expected Arrival Date Time; Visit Actual Arrival Date Time; Visit Expected Departure Date Time; Visit Actual Departure Date Time; Visit Anchorage; Visit Receiving Facility Name; Visit Location In Port Reference.

items.label: Visit Anchorage
items.description: An anchorage a vessel will use while at a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitAnchorageText.

items.label: Visit Location In Port Reference
items.description: A location of a vessel in a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitLocationInPort. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Visit Receiving Facility Name
items.description: A name of a facility that will receive a vessel while at a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitReceivingFacilityName.

items.label: Visit Actual Arrival Date Time
items.description: A date and time when a vessel actually arrived at a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitActualArrivalDateTime.

items.label: Visit Actual Departure Date Time
items.description: A date and time when a vessel actually departed from a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitActualDepartureDateTime.

items.label: Visit Expected Arrival Date Time
items.description: A date and time a vessel is expected to arrive at a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitExpectedArrivalDateTime.

items.label: Visit Expected Departure Date Time
items.description: A date and time a vessel is expected to depart from a port. NIEM 6.0 m:VisitExpectedDepartureDateTime.

items.label: Port
items.description: A data type for a facility capable of receiving vessels and transferring cargo. NIEM 6.0 m:PortType. Members: Port Name; Port Code; Port UNLOCODE; Port BE Number; Port Description; city-name (Default); region-name (Default); country-code-iso-3166 (Default); Port Government; Port Operational Status; Port ISPS Compliant Indicator; Port Threat Level; Port Dock Quantity; Port Pilot Boat Quantity; Port Maximum Vessel Quantity; Port Anchorage Capability; Port Cargo Capability; Port Depth; Port Strategic Port Of Embarkation Indicator.

items.label: Port ISPS Compliant Indicator
items.description: True if a port is compliant with International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) requirements; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 m:PortISPSCompliantIndicator.

items.label: Port Strategic Port Of Embarkation Indicator
items.description: True if troops, munitions, etc. can be loaded/unloaded at this port; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 m:PortStrategicPortOfEmbarkationIndicator.

items.label: Port Anchorage Capability
items.description: A description of the anchorage capabilities of a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortAnchorageCapabilityText.

items.label: Port BE Number
items.description: A BE (Basic Encyclopedia) number for a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortBENumberText.

items.label: Port Cargo Capability
items.description: A description of the cargo capabilities of a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortCargoCapabilityText.

items.label: Port Code
items.description: A code to identify a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortCodeText.

items.label: Port Description
items.description: A description of a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortDescriptionText.

items.label: Port Government
items.description: A government which owns or operates a port, especially in the situation where a port is physically in one country but is owned or operated by another. NIEM 6.0 m:PortGovernmentText.

items.label: Port Name
items.description: A name of a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortName.

items.label: Port Operational Status
items.description: An operational status of a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortOperationalStatus. The status as text (nc:StatusText).

items.label: Port Threat Level
items.description: A threat level at a port. NIEM 6.0 m:PortThreatLevelText.

items.label: Port UNLOCODE
